reconcile.note: Jamieson, Fausset & Brown read Paul's all Israel as a future national ingathering distinct from the unbelieving remnant Jesus threatens with exclusion in Matthew.

discrepancy.note: Strauss reads Jesus's saying that the children of the kingdom, the Jews, will be cast out as flatly reassigning Israel's promised place to the Gentiles.

quotes.text: the children of the kingdom (obviously the Jews), for whom it was originally designed, will be cast out ( Matt. viii. 11 f. ).
quotes.attr: David Friedrich Strauss (d. 1874), The Life of Jesus Critically Examined, on Matthew 8:12.
